answer: Reaching eligibility takes 82 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The ridge register is checked at draw time, jetty lists the eligible set, and tide seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 82 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 70 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
